- **final_answer**: Call this when you are done with the task. Provide the list of URLs that answer the user's question and the task state (completed, partial, failed, or unclear).

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

Italian football referee

Luca Banti

|  |  |  |  |

| Full name | Luca Banti | | |
| Born | (1974-03-27) 27 March 1974 (age 51) [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"), [Italy](/wiki/Italy "Italy") | | |

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

Italian football referee

Luca Banti

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

Italian football referee

Luca Banti

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). **Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). **Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

Italian football referee

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

Italian football referee

Luca Banti

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia

Italian football referee

Luca Banti

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

Italian football referee

Luca Banti

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

Italian football referee

Luca Banti

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)

**Luca Banti** (Italian: [[ˈluːka ˈbanti]](/wiki/Help:IPA/Italian "Help:IPA/Italian"); born 27 March 1974 in [Livorno](/wiki/Livorno "Livorno"))[[1]](#cite_note-1) is an [Italian](/wiki/Italians "Italians") [football](/wiki/Association_football "Association football") [referee](/wiki/Referee_(association_football) "Referee (association football)"). In 2009, he became a UEFA Category three referee and at the start of 2010 he was promoted to category two and later to category one.

Banti became a [FIFA](/wiki/FIFA_International_Referees_List "FIFA International Referees List") referee in 2009.[[2]](#cite_note-2) He has served as a referee in [2014 World Cup qualifiers](/wiki/2014_FIFA_World_Cup_qualification_(UEFA) "2014 FIFA World Cup qualification (UEFA)").[[3]](#cite_note-3)
